{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my connected-home setup, but I would choose the larger Echo Show 8 this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try the larger display for video calling and convenient control of compatible home devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try automating a lamp as a useful addition to my Alexa-enabled setup.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The doorbell interests me, but I already have security cameras and do not currently need an entire bundle.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Voice control fits my devices, but I would choose the Echo Show 8 instead of adding another Alexa device today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Indoor monitoring fits my interests, but three more cameras exceed my current needs.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could complement my connected home, but the smart display serves a clearer purpose for me right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD streaming stick adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent interests concern home viewing and security; I have no current need for Alexa in a car.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing streaming devices cover this use, and the themed cover gives me no practical reason to add another."}
